description: This file contains unit tests for the Role class in the Goteo application, verifying role creation, permissions management, and role hierarchy features.

classes.name: RoleTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Role class functionalities in the Goteo application.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests that a Role object can be instantiated and is of the expected class type.

methods.name: testDefaults
methods.description: Verifies the default behavior of getRolePerms for a non-existent role and exception thrown when adding permissions to a non-existent role.

methods.name: testAddRoles
methods.description: Tests adding multiple roles to the system and verifies their presence and permissions.

methods.name: testExtendedRoles
methods.description: Checks that roles extend permissions from other roles correctly.

methods.name: testRoleExists
methods.description: Validates existence checks for specific roles.

methods.name: testRoleGetPerm
methods.description: Verifies that role permissions are retrieved accurately.

methods.name: testRoleHasPerm
methods.description: Checks whether roles have specific permissions.

methods.name: testAddPermissions
methods.description: Tests adding permissions to roles and verifies their properties.
